hook_text: A message that doubles every day reaches 1 024 new people by day 10.
clip_script: Back to the message story. On day one, two people get the message. If each person who received it passes it on to two new people the next day, the number of new people on day five is two to the power five, thirty-two. Powers grow very fast: by day ten it would be two to the tenth, 1 024.
visual_style: A phone sends a message to two phones, which branch to four, eight, sixteen; a counter climbs to 32 and then 1 024.
pacing: Branching animation accelerates; pause on 2⁵ notation.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to learn the base, the exponent and how to compare powers.
